# `oaap app maintenance`

only administrators pass; everybody else sees a 'back soon' page (RFC-0059).

**Root:** needs `sudo`.

## Usage

```sh
oaap app maintenance [--message MESSAGE]
                            [--tenant INSTANCE_TENANT]
                            name {on,off}
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `name` | -- |
| `switch` | (one of `on`, `off`) |
| `--message MESSAGE` | the sentence shown to visitors |
| `--tenant INSTANCE_TENANT` | tenant label: read the instance as a NAME inside this tenant (also: <tenant>/<name>) |
